scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/registry build && bun run --filter '@kernelui-lib/*' build
scripts.dev: bun run --cwd packages/react build && bun scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.docs:build: bun run --cwd packages/registry build && bun run --cwd packages/react build && bun run --cwd apps/docs build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/react test && bun run --cwd packages/cli test
